<output>{"issues":[{"number":74,"tag":"easy-call","duplicate_of":null,"comment":"`easy-call`: preserve collection filters when the fetch join is reattached outside the pagination subquery.

The failure is in `CollectionFetchPaginationQueryTransformer` and `ExpressionReplacementWalker`: the rewritten join predicate contains a rendered `FilterPredicate`, whose generic visitor rejects it. The fetched table group moves with the aliases referenced by its collection filters. Keep those rendered predicates and their original JDBC bindings in the pagination-specific rewriter and continue rewriting structured owner column references. Leave the default filter visitors unchanged for other SQL AST transformations.

Two-way. This changes query-plan construction only; there is no public API, schema, or mapping change. No duplicate in the batch.

- [Baseline](https://github.com/xfocus3/hibernate-work/actions/runs/45732075076): parameterized filter fails with the reported exception; the unfiltered control passes.
- [Focused candidate](https://github.com/xfocus3/hibernate-work/actions/runs/45735159948): 16 H2 tests pass, without skips. Covers explicit child alias, both Boolean values and stable parent pagination, and an inner many-to-many link filter affecting page membership and fetched children.

Reapply the minimal candidate on the synchronized base, rerun exact-source compile/format and focused pagination tests, and verify changes before a Work PR."}],"patterns":""}</output>
